views.definition:
SELECT s.repo_id,
    s.experiment_type,
    r.arm,
    count(DISTINCT s.session_id) AS sessions,
    count(DISTINCT s.task_id) AS distinct_tasks,
    count(DISTINCT o.run_id) FILTER (WHERE o.producer_conformant) AS conformant_runs,
    count(DISTINCT o.run_id) AS total_runs,
    count(DISTINCT j.id) AS judgments,
    s.phase
   FROM (((arm_eval_sessions s
     JOIN arm_eval_runs r ON ((r.session_id = s.session_id)))
     LEFT JOIN arm_eval_outputs o ON ((o.run_id = r.run_id)))
     LEFT JOIN arm_eval_judgments j ON ((j.run_id = r.run_id)))
  GROUP BY s.repo_id, s.experiment_type, r.arm, s.phase;

SELECT r.id AS repo_id,
    r.name AS repo_name,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = 'confirmed_hit'::text)) AS confirmed_hits,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = 'audit_missed'::text)) AS audit_misses,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = 'audit_false_positive'::text)) AS audit_false_positives,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = 'severity_understated'::text)) AS severity_understated,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = 'severity_overstated'::text)) AS severity_overstated,
    round((NULLIF((count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = 'confirmed_hit'::text)))::numeric, (0)::numeric) / NULLIF((count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = ANY (ARRAY['confirmed_hit'::text, 'audit_false_positive'::text]))))::numeric, (0)::numeric)), 3) AS user_visible_precision,
    round((NULLIF((count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = 'confirmed_hit'::text)))::numeric, (0)::numeric) / NULLIF((count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = ANY (ARRAY['confirmed_hit'::text, 'audit_missed'::text]))))::numeric, (0)::numeric)), 3) AS user_visible_recall
   FROM ((audit_repos r
     LEFT JOIN persona_test_sessions s ON ((s.repo_name = r.name)))
     LEFT JOIN persona_audit_correlations c ON ((c.persona_session_id = s.id)))
  GROUP BY r.id, r.name;

SELECT repo_id,
    severity,
    deferred_reason,
    count(*) AS count,
    min(deferred_at) AS oldest,
    max(deferred_at) AS newest,
    array_agg(DISTINCT category) AS categories
   FROM debt_entries
  GROUP BY repo_id, severity, deferred_reason
  ORDER BY
        CASE severity
            WHEN 'HIGH'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'MEDIUM'::text THEN 2
            ELSE 3
        END, (count(*)) DESC;

WITH ps AS (
         SELECT ps.run_id,
            r.commit_sha,
            COALESCE(r.assignment_id, r.commit_sha, (r.id)::text) AS assignment_id,
            COALESCE(r.stage_type, 'audit-code'::text) AS stage_type,
            r.phase,
            COALESCE(r.prompt_variant, 'default'::text) AS prompt_variant,
            ps.stage,
            ps.cost_usd,
            ps.structured_output_ok,
            ps.usage_unmeterable,
            model_ab_attribute_arms(ps.stage, ps.arm) AS arms
           FROM (audit_pass_stats ps
             JOIN audit_runs r ON ((r.id = ps.run_id)))
          WHERE (ps.stage IS NOT NULL)
        ), exp AS (
         SELECT ps.assignment_id,
            ps.commit_sha,
            ps.stage_type,
            ps.phase,
            ps.prompt_variant,
            ps.cost_usd,
            ps.structured_output_ok,
            ps.usage_unmeterable,
            unnest(ps.arms) AS arm
           FROM ps
          WHERE (ps.arms <> ARRAY['__INVALID__'::text])
        )
 SELECT assignment_id,
    commit_sha,
    stage_type,
    phase,
    prompt_variant,
    arm,
    sum(cost_usd) AS standalone_cost_usd,
    bool_and((cost_usd IS NOT NULL)) AS cost_known,
    count(*) AS pass_executions,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE structured_output_ok) AS conformant_passes,
    bool_or(usage_unmeterable) AS any_unmeterable
   FROM exp
  GROUP BY assignment_id, commit_sha, stage_type, phase, prompt_variant, arm;

WITH canon AS (
         SELECT f.run_id,
            r.commit_sha,
            COALESCE(r.assignment_id, r.commit_sha, (r.id)::text) AS assignment_id,
            COALESCE(r.stage_type, 'audit-code'::text) AS stage_type,
            f.stage,
            f.arm AS explicit_arm,
            f.source_model,
            f.severity,
            COALESCE(f.adjudication_outcome, 'pending'::text) AS outcome,
            COALESCE(fe.canonical_finding_id, f.finding_fingerprint) AS canonical_id,
            model_ab_attribute_arms(f.stage, f.arm) AS arms
           FROM ((audit_findings f
             JOIN audit_runs r ON ((r.id = f.run_id)))
             LEFT JOIN finding_equivalence fe ON ((fe.duplicate_finding_id = f.finding_fingerprint)))
        ), expanded AS (
         SELECT canon.run_id,
            canon.commit_sha,
            canon.assignment_id,
            canon.stage_type,
            unnest(canon.arms) AS arm,
            canon.stage,
            canon.source_model,
            canon.severity,
            canon.outcome,
            canon.canonical_id
           FROM canon
          WHERE (canon.arms <> ARRAY['__INVALID__'::text])
        ), pass_cost AS (
         SELECT audit_pass_stats.run_id,
            audit_pass_stats.stage,
            audit_pass_stats.source_model,
            sum(audit_pass_stats.cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
            count(*) AS pass_executions,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE audit_pass_stats.structured_output_ok) AS conformant_passes,
            bool_or(audit_pass_stats.usage_unmeterable) AS any_unmeterable
           FROM audit_pass_stats
          WHERE (audit_pass_stats.stage IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY audit_pass_stats.run_id, audit_pass_stats.stage, audit_pass_stats.source_model
        )
 SELECT e.run_id,
    e.arm,
    e.stage,
    e.source_model,
    count(DISTINCT e.canonical_id) FILTER (WHERE (e.outcome = 'accepted'::text)) AS accepted_uniques,
    count(DISTINCT e.canonical_id) FILTER (WHERE (e.outcome = 'dismissed'::text)) AS dismissed_uniques,
    count(DISTINCT e.canonical_id) FILTER (WHERE (e.outcome = 'pending'::text)) AS pending_uniques,
    count(DISTINCT e.canonical_id) AS total_uniques,
    count(DISTINCT e.canonical_id) FILTER (WHERE ((e.severity = 'HIGH'::text) AND (e.outcome = 'accepted'::text))) AS accepted_high,
    pc.cost_usd,
    pc.pass_executions,
    pc.conformant_passes,
        CASE
            WHEN (pc.pass_executions > 0) THEN round(((pc.conformant_passes)::numeric / (pc.pass_executions)::numeric), 4)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS conformance_rate,
    pc.any_unmeterable,
    e.commit_sha,
    e.stage_type,
    e.assignment_id
   FROM (expanded e
     LEFT JOIN pass_cost pc ON (((pc.run_id = e.run_id) AND (pc.stage = e.stage) AND (COALESCE(pc.source_model, ''::text) = COALESCE(e.source_model, ''::text)))))
  GROUP BY e.run_id, e.arm, e.stage, e.source_model, e.commit_sha, e.stage_type, e.assignment_id, pc.cost_usd, pc.pass_executions, pc.conformant_passes, pc.any_unmeterable;

WITH canon AS (
         SELECT f.run_id,
            r.commit_sha,
            COALESCE(r.assignment_id, r.commit_sha, (r.id)::text) AS assignment_id,
            COALESCE(r.stage_type, 'audit-code'::text) AS stage_type,
            r.phase,
            COALESCE(r.prompt_variant, 'default'::text) AS prompt_variant,
            f.finding_fingerprint,
            f.stage,
            f.source_model,
            f.severity,
            COALESCE(f.adjudication_outcome, 'pending'::text) AS outcome,
            COALESCE(f.remediation_state, 'pending'::text) AS remediation_state,
            COALESCE(f.is_quick_fix, false) AS is_quick_fix,
            COALESCE(fe.canonical_finding_id, f.finding_fingerprint) AS canonical_id,
            model_ab_attribute_arms(f.stage, f.arm) AS arms
           FROM ((audit_findings f
             JOIN audit_runs r ON ((r.id = f.run_id)))
             LEFT JOIN finding_equivalence fe ON ((fe.duplicate_finding_id = f.finding_fingerprint)))
        )
 SELECT run_id,
    commit_sha,
    assignment_id,
    stage_type,
    phase,
    prompt_variant,
    unnest(arms) AS arm,
    stage,
    source_model,
    finding_fingerprint,
    canonical_id,
    severity,
    outcome,
    remediation_state,
    is_quick_fix
   FROM canon
  WHERE (arms <> ARRAY['__INVALID__'::text]);

SELECT id,
    repo_id,
    cluster_hash,
    severity_history,
    first_seen,
    last_seen,
    occurrence_count,
    latest_finding_id,
    files_affected,
    cluster_label,
    status
   FROM recurring_finding_clusters
  WHERE ((occurrence_count >= 3) AND (status = 'open'::text) AND (('HIGH'::text = ANY (severity_history)) OR ((occurrence_count >= 5) AND ('MEDIUM'::text = ANY (severity_history)))))
  ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC, last_seen DESC
 LIMIT 50;

SELECT af.id,
    ar.repo_id,
    af.severity,
    af.category AS title,
    af.detail_snapshot AS body,
    af.dismiss_reason,
    af.primary_file,
    af.created_at,
    ar.commit_sha,
    ar.branch
   FROM (audit_findings af
     JOIN audit_runs ar ON ((ar.id = af.run_id)))
  WHERE (af.user_action = 'needs_triage'::text)
  ORDER BY
        CASE
            WHEN (af.severity = 'HIGH'::text) THEN 0
            WHEN (af.severity = 'MEDIUM'::text) THEN 1
            ELSE 2
        END, af.created_at DESC;

SELECT persona_test_sessions.url,
    (f.value ->> 'element'::text) AS element,
    (f.value ->> 'observed'::text) AS observed,
    (f.value ->> 'fix'::text) AS fix_direction,
    count(*) AS sessions_seen,
    min(persona_test_sessions.created_at) AS first_seen,
    max(persona_test_sessions.created_at) AS last_seen
   FROM persona_test_sessions,
    LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(persona_test_sessions.findings) f(value)
  WHERE (((f.value ->> 'code'::text) = 'P0'::text) AND (((f.value ->> 'confidence'::text))::numeric >= 0.7))
  GROUP BY persona_test_sessions.url, (f.value ->> 'element'::text), (f.value ->> 'observed'::text), (f.value ->> 'fix'::text)
 HAVING (count(*) >= 2)
  ORDER BY (count(*)) DESC;

WITH ranked AS (
         SELECT i.plan_id,
            i.criterion_hash,
            i.description,
            i.severity,
            i.category,
            i.passed,
            i.skipped,
            i.created_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY i.plan_id, i.criterion_hash ORDER BY i.created_at DESC) AS rn
           FROM plan_verification_items i
        )
 SELECT plan_id,
    criterion_hash,
    description,
    severity,
    category,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((NOT passed) AND (NOT skipped))) AS fail_count_last_5,
    max(created_at) FILTER (WHERE ((NOT passed) AND (NOT skipped))) AS last_failure_at
   FROM ranked
  WHERE (rn <= 5)
  GROUP BY plan_id, criterion_hash, description, severity, category
 HAVING (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((NOT passed) AND (NOT skipped))) >= 2)
  ORDER BY severity, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((NOT passed) AND (NOT skipped)))) DESC;

SELECT id,
    name,
    app_url,
    app_name,
    description,
    notes,
    test_count,
    last_tested_at,
    last_verdict,
    last_focus,
        CASE
            WHEN (last_tested_at IS NULL) THEN NULL::integer
            ELSE (EXTRACT(day FROM (now() - last_tested_at)))::integer
        END AS days_since_last_test,
    ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date', (s.created_at)::date, 'verdict', s.verdict, 'focus', s.focus, 'p0', s.p0_count, 'p1', s.p1_count) ORDER BY s.created_at DESC) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT persona_test_sessions.id,
                    persona_test_sessions.created_at,
                    persona_test_sessions.session_id,
                    persona_test_sessions.persona,
                    persona_test_sessions.url,
                    persona_test_sessions.focus,
                    persona_test_sessions.browser_tool,
                    persona_test_sessions.steps_taken,
                    persona_test_sessions.duration_ms,
                    persona_test_sessions.verdict,
                    persona_test_sessions.p0_count,
                    persona_test_sessions.p1_count,
                    persona_test_sessions.p2_count,
                    persona_test_sessions.p3_count,
                    persona_test_sessions.avg_confidence,
                    persona_test_sessions.findings,
                    persona_test_sessions.report_md,
                    persona_test_sessions.debrief_md,
                    persona_test_sessions.persona_id
                   FROM persona_test_sessions
                  WHERE (persona_test_sessions.persona_id = p.id)
                  ORDER BY persona_test_sessions.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 5) s) AS recent_sessions
   FROM personas p
  ORDER BY app_url, last_tested_at NULLS FIRST;

SELECT r.id AS repo_id,
    r.name AS repo_name,
    (COALESCE(count(pts.id) FILTER (WHERE (pts.created_at > (now() - '30 days'::interval))), (0)::bigint))::integer AS density_30d
   FROM (audit_repos r
     LEFT JOIN persona_test_sessions pts ON ((pts.repo_name = r.name)))
  GROUP BY r.id, r.name;

SELECT p.id AS plan_id,
    p.path AS plan_path,
    p.skill AS plan_skill,
    p.status AS plan_status,
    r.id AS latest_run_id,
    r.created_at AS last_verified_at,
    r.commit_sha AS verified_commit_sha,
    r.url AS verified_url,
    r.total_criteria,
    r.passed_count,
    r.failed_count,
    r.skipped_count,
    round((NULLIF((100.0 * (r.passed_count)::numeric), (0)::numeric) / (NULLIF(r.total_criteria, 0))::numeric), 1) AS satisfaction_pct,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('description', i.description, 'category', i.category, 'error', i.error_message, 'hash', i.criterion_hash)), '[]'::jsonb) AS "coalesce"
           FROM plan_verification_items i
          WHERE ((i.run_id = r.id) AND (i.passed = false) AND (i.skipped = false) AND (i.severity = 'P0'::text))) AS failing_p0_criteria,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('description', i.description, 'category', i.category, 'error', i.error_message, 'hash', i.criterion_hash)), '[]'::jsonb) AS "coalesce"
           FROM plan_verification_items i
          WHERE ((i.run_id = r.id) AND (i.passed = false) AND (i.skipped = false) AND (i.severity = 'P1'::text))) AS failing_p1_criteria
   FROM (plans p
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT plan_verification_runs.id,
            plan_verification_runs.plan_id,
            plan_verification_runs.spec_id,
            plan_verification_runs.commit_sha,
            plan_verification_runs.url,
            plan_verification_runs.total_criteria,
            plan_verification_runs.passed_count,
            plan_verification_runs.failed_count,
            plan_verification_runs.skipped_count,
            plan_verification_runs.duration_ms,
            plan_verification_runs.run_context,
            plan_verification_runs.created_at,
            plan_verification_runs.selector_policy_violations
           FROM plan_verification_runs
          WHERE (plan_verification_runs.plan_id = p.id)
          ORDER BY plan_verification_runs.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) r ON (true));

SELECT persona_test_sessions.url,
    (f.value ->> 'element'::text) AS element,
    (f.value ->> 'code'::text) AS severity,
    (f.value ->> 'observed'::text) AS observed,
    count(*) AS occurrence_count,
    max(persona_test_sessions.created_at) AS last_seen
   FROM persona_test_sessions,
    LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(persona_test_sessions.findings) f(value)
  WHERE (((f.value ->> 'confidence'::text))::numeric >= 0.6)
  GROUP BY persona_test_sessions.url, (f.value ->> 'element'::text), (f.value ->> 'code'::text), (f.value ->> 'observed'::text)
 HAVING (count(*) >= 2)
  ORDER BY (count(*)) DESC, (max(persona_test_sessions.created_at)) DESC;

SELECT rs.id AS spec_id,
    rs.spec_path,
    rs.description,
    rs.source_kind,
    rr.commit_sha,
    rr.error_message,
    rr.created_at AS caught_at
   FROM (regression_specs rs
     JOIN regression_spec_runs rr ON ((rr.spec_id = rs.id)))
  WHERE (rr.captured_regression = true)
  ORDER BY rr.created_at DESC;

SELECT reason.value AS reason_code,
    count(*) AS occurrences,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (se.overridden_by_user = true)) AS overridden,
    round(((100.0 * (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (se.overridden_by_user = true)))::numeric) / (NULLIF(count(*), 0))::numeric), 1) AS override_pct
   FROM ship_events se,
    LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(se.block_reasons) reason(value)
  GROUP BY reason.value
  ORDER BY (count(*)) DESC;

SELECT f.id AS audit_finding_id,
    f.run_id AS audit_run_id,
    r.repo_id,
    f.severity,
    f.category,
    f.primary_file,
    f.detail_snapshot,
    r.created_at AS fixed_at,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM regression_specs rs
          WHERE ((rs.source_finding_type = 'audit'::text) AND (rs.source_finding_id = f.id) AND (rs.source_kind <> 'persona-consistency-candidate'::text))) AS lock_spec_count
   FROM (audit_findings f
     JOIN audit_runs r ON ((r.id = f.run_id)))
  WHERE ((f.severity = 'HIGH'::text) AND (f.adjudication_outcome = ANY (ARRAY['accepted'::text, 'severity_adjusted'::text])) AND (f.remediation_state = ANY (ARRAY['fixed'::text, 'verified'::text])) AND (r.created_at > (now() - '14 days'::interval)) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM regression_specs rs
          WHERE ((rs.source_finding_type = 'audit'::text) AND (rs.source_finding_id = f.id) AND (rs.source_kind <> 'persona-consistency-candidate'::text))))));

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (run_id, output_hash) REFERENCES arm_eval_outputs(run_id, output_hash)
CHECK (((arm IS NULL) OR (arm = ANY (ARRAY['A'::text, 'B'::text, 'C'::text])))) NOT VALID
CHECK (((stage IS NULL) OR (stage <> ALL (ARRAY['gemini'::text, 'gpt-round'::text])) OR (arm IS NOT NULL))) NOT VALID
FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES audit_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK ((((sonar_type IS NULL) AND (effort IS NULL) AND (source_kind IS NULL) AND (source_name IS NULL)) OR ((sonar_type IS NOT NULL) AND (effort IS NOT NULL) AND (source_kind IS NOT NULL) AND (source_name IS NOT NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES audit_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (plan_id) REFERENCES plans(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
CHECK (((stage_type IS NULL) OR (stage_type = ANY (ARRAY['plan'::text, 'audit-plan'::text, 'audit-code'::text])))) NOT VALID

CHECK (((deferred_reason = 'out-of-scope'::text) OR ((deferred_reason = 'blocked-by'::text) AND (blocked_by IS NOT NULL)) OR ((deferred_reason = 'deferred-followup'::text) AND (followup_pr IS NOT NULL)) OR ((deferred_reason = 'accepted-permanent'::text) AND (approver IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((deferred_reason = 'policy-exception'::text) AND (policy_ref IS NOT NULL) AND (approver IS NOT NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (repo_id) REFERENCES audit_repos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (repo_id) REFERENCES audit_repos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (repo_id) REFERENCES audit_repos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

FOREIGN KEY (finding_id) REFERENCES audit_findings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (audit_run_id) REFERENCES audit_runs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (repo_id) REFERENCES audit_repos(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
CHECK ((((audit_run_id IS NOT NULL) AND (round IS NOT NULL) AND (sequence IS NOT NULL)) OR (external_id IS NOT NULL)))
FOREIGN KEY (audit_run_id) REFERENCES audit_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (repo_id) REFERENCES audit_repos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (repo_id) REFERENCES audit_repos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES model_eval_runs(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (model_eval_run_id) REFERENCES model_eval_runs(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (audit_finding_id) REFERENCES audit_findings(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (audit_run_id) REFERENCES audit_runs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (persona_session_id) REFERENCES persona_test_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (last_seen_session_id) REFERENCES persona_test_sessions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (repo_id) REFERENCES audit_repos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (((outcome <> ALL (ARRAY['dismissed'::text, 'wont_fix'::text])) OR ((rationale IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(rationale)) > 0))))
FOREIGN KEY (persona_id) REFERENCES personas(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
CHECK (((last_verdict = ANY (ARRAY['Ready for users'::text, 'Needs work'::text, 'Blocked'::text])) OR (last_verdict IS NULL)))
FOREIGN KEY (plan_id) REFERENCES plans(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES plan_verification_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (plan_id) REFERENCES plans(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (spec_id) REFERENCES regression_specs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (repo_id) REFERENCES audit_repos(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (latest_finding_id) REFERENCES audit_findings(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (repo_id) REFERENCES audit_repos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
